Bottom left: Future Belgrave lasses (!) showing their paces in the childrens races. Bottom right: Ronnie McCrossen, winner of the Junior 200 metres.

In the 110m Hurdles Paul Whitby ran in devastating fashion to put up a particularly good time on the Battersea Park cinders and take the championship at his first attempt. Decathlon man Reg Hopkins was 2nd and Ronnie McCrossen snatched a narrow margin over Steve Crosbie for 3rd.

…lderness, Pete Carton under 2 minutes, Colin Pearson - a good double performance, another best from Leo Coy, youngsters Ronnie McCrossen and Michael Manning, two very good relay runs, Paul Whitby's hurdles, Paul Williamson's two excellent runs, and of course Snowy's eight events.…
Hopkins,Jnr. has firmly established himself and two more youngsters who have made auspicious beginnings in the event are Youths Ronnie McCrossen and David Didino.
